data.name: Valentine's Day Sail
data.headline: Set Sail On A Romantic Valentine's Day Weekend Sail
data.description:
Set Sail on a Romantic Midday or Sunset Sail this Valentine's Day. 

Choose Your Sail: 
⛵ Book a Private Sail for you and your plus 1 
⛵ Departure times: Midday Sail 11:00-2:00 or Sunset Sail 3:00-6:00 
 
Valentine's Day Special Add-On Packages: 
- Add on our Keepsake Package at checkout and get a cooler backpack, bottle of champagne + keepsake flutes, waterproof disposable camera, and a blanket embroidered with your San Diego departure coordinates.
- Charcuterie board for two + a bottle of bubbly 

Celebrate Valentine's Day all weekend long with these special add-ons! Available to book Friday-Sunday, February 13th - 15th.

data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy**
We understand things happen and plans change, that's why we have the most flexible cancellation policy in the industry. Reservations are 100% refundable if canceled outside of 72 hours of the date of the departure. 

**Weather Policy**
Sail San Diego does not operate in unsafe weather conditions, but a light rain shower is not a deterrent. The Captain will assess the weather and should the Captain determine that the conditions are unsafe to run the charter, the charter may be rescheduled or it will be canceled.

- If a trip is canceled by Sail San Diego for any reason, you will have the option of receiving store credit for a future trip or receiving a full refund.
